edges.reason: owner is initialized from msg.sender at construction time
msg.sender is pushed into playerPool by buyIn and the fallback
onlyBy(owner) gates changeOwner on msg.sender == owner
buyIn uses msg.sender and msg.value from the untrusted caller
fallback pushes msg.sender into the pool
block.timestamp (now) is fed into the pseudo-random seed, making payout miner/validator influenceable
modifier _account drives the onlyBy authorization check on changeOwner
changeOwner writes _newOwner into the owner state variable
upper bounds the modulo result returned by random()
seed is both read and written inside random()
random() hashes playerPool[playerPool.length - 1] as entropy source
playerPool is indexed in selectWinner to obtain the winner
selectWinner indexes the pool with predictable random() output, allowing winner prediction
buyIn calls selectWinner once playerPool.length >= 11
fallback calls selectWinner once playerPool.length >= 11
selectWinner sends ether with winner.transfer(amount) before clearing playerPool.length
the player-controlled recipient of winner.transfer can re-enter selectWinner while the pool and balances are not yet reset
amount state variable is the value transferred to the winner
local winner (derived from attacker-influenced pool) is the ether transfer recipient
after the winner payout the function sweeps the full balance to owner via owner.transfer(this.balance)
refund() performs an external transfer to each pool member inside a loop
loop index i selects the playerPool entry that is paid in refund()
close() invokes refund() before destroying the contract
close() executes selfdestruct(owner)
msg.value * 10 comparison decides whether buyIn reverts or accepts the deposit
msg.value * 10 == 0.1 ether require gates the fallback deposit
seed % upper modulo computation produces the returned random index
playerPool.length - 1 subtraction computes the final-element index hashed into the seed

normalization_plan.reason: _account is only the modifier parameter used by the onlyBy(owner) guard on changeOwner, so it is folded into the gated function
_newOwner is the sole input written to owner inside changeOwner and has no independent semantic identity
upper only bounds the modulo inside random() and disappears once the internal helper is summarized
loop counter i exists only to drive the refund() transfer loop and carries no separate meaning
local winner is a transient alias for the pool entry paid out in selectWinner and is absorbed into that function
